about: RMCProfile's own output on a synthetic configuration (fcc Ni, 8x8x8 cells, 2048 atoms, seeded Gaussian displacements of 0.08 A, no moves: TIME_LIMIT 0), written by RMCProfile 6.9.0-rc.0 (git 11d08adc, macOS arm64, build 2026-10-27) on 2026-11-07, to establish how it computes the model G(r) of a real-space fit (rmc_toolkits/ripples.py, tests/test_ripples.py). Neutron datasets 1-3 fit the same G(r) file: 1 with CONVOLVE :: 20.0 (R_CUTOFF defaulted to the minimum distance, 2.0 A), 2 without CONVOLVE, 3 with CONVOLVE :: 20.0 and R_CUTOFF :: 0.5. The X-ray real-space dataset (a second run on the same configuration) has QMIN 0.0, QMAX 20.0, QSTEP 0.01; its file is written to 7 decimals. Every dataset's r grid is `r` (the X-ray file's 7-decimal r column agrees with it to 1e-15).
